title: Charts in Excel
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 2 Week 5 Study sheet pp.40-45

scenes.t: A chart is a picture of your worksheet data. Charts turn numbers into shapes and colors, so we understand them quickly.
For example, Yahia counts fruits: 5 apples, 3 bananas, and 4 oranges.
To make a chart: type your numbers in Excel, select them with the mouse, then click Insert, and choose a chart.
A bar chart uses tall bars to compare things.
A pie chart looks like a round pie divided into slices.
A line chart shows how something changes over time.
You can change the colors, and add a title to your chart.
Charts make it easy to compare large amounts of data.
